title: Drill: Put the Boot in Order

questions.prompt: What happens FIRST when the power comes on?
options: The boot block is read from disk
The CPU starts executing at a fixed address in firmware ROM

questions.prompt: What does the firmware code load next, in a two-step boot?
options: The boot block, from a fixed location on disk

questions.prompt: What does the boot block's code load?

options: Lets you choose a kernel, then loads it into memory and starts it

questions.prompt: Which step happens LAST of these?
In a one-step boot, the bootstrap loader in ROM or EEPROM loads the kernel directly, with no boot block.
A new kernel won't start. Which bootstrap loader's menu lets you pick last week's kernel instead? (one word)
